shape: residual-decided lethality: the representative-roll collapse erases a surviving outcome that a later end-of-turn residual would have produced
was: reports/c88 sub-shape B, filed NOT YET DETERMINED pending the branch-set check

the_deciding_check.question: is the OBSERVED outcome present in ANY engine arm? If yes it is a branch-set-versus-sample comparison limit; if no it is an engine gap.
the_deciding_check.result: CORRECTED. Absent in THREE of four, not four. 19000074/27's p2 net IS reachable via the 1.56% crit-kill arm; it fails on the OTHER slot. See EVIDENCE_TABLE_REGENERATED_FROM_REPLAY.
the_deciding_check.therefore: ENGINE GAP for three rows. The fourth is a separate, newly-identified cause and is open.
the_deciding_check.19000074_27_precision: its p2 NET is reachable via the 1.56% crit-kill arm, but the COMPONENTS are not: observed p2 is move=-241 plus capped_lethal=-3 (survived the hit at 3, died to sandstorm), while the arm is capped_lethal=-244 alone (died to the hit). Only the net coincides. Given C94 retracted a whole method for conflating a net with a component set, this distinction is load-bearing.

worked_example.story: Blaziken at 118/262. Ursaring's Hidden Power rolls -100, leaving 18; Sandstorm takes 16; Blaziken SURVIVES at 2 and eats its Salac Berry. The engine's representative roll is -107, leaving 11; Sandstorm then kills.
worked_example.engine_arms: 6.25% miss (net 0) and 93.75% hit at -107 plus capped_lethal -11. No arm survives.
worked_example.the_mechanism: the direct hit cannot KO in either case (max_damage ~115 < hp 118), so generate_instructions.rs takes its Case B path at ~2887 and collapses the sixteen 85-100 rolls to one 0.925 representative. But a later END-OF-TURN RESIDUAL makes that same roll range straddle a lethality threshold: -100 survives sandstorm, -107 does not. The engine's straddle tests only ask whether the DIRECT hit kills (max_damage_dealt >= defender_active.hp at ~2849, max_damage_dealt < hp at ~2877). Neither considers residual damage, so the surviving outcome is never enumerated.

why_this_is_the_same_family_as_C27_and_C: both were representative-roll collapses that erased a reachable position a LATER effect reads -- C27 the KO threshold within the crit range, C31 the quarter-HP Substitute gate. This is the third instance: the reader is end-of-turn residual damage rather than a same-turn move.

disposition.the_fix: extend the straddle test to account for pending end-of-turn residual damage: partition when (max_damage + residual) >= hp and (min_damage + residual) < hp, using the identity compare_health_with_damage_multiples already provides. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED -- residual magnitude depends on weather, item, status and ability, so computing it at that point needs care and a cost measurement, exactly as C87 did.
disposition.search_cost_warning: this adds a partition to every damaging move against a defender with a pending residual, which is common. C87 showed a branch-count change can be an 8x regression when it fires on the wrong path. Measure branch counts and the tactics suite before shipping.

PRIOR_TEXT.hypothesis: the 24 rows adjudicated as limit:roll_divergent_lethality might be this same mechanism misfiled
PRIOR_TEXT.test: sample 8 of them and ask whether the observed net is absent from every arm and a residual is present
PRIOR_TEXT.result: 0 of 8. Their observed net is usually PRESENT in an arm (19000001/11 obs -92 against arms [-92, 0]), which is the genuine branch-set-versus-sample case. The existing comparison-limit adjudication for that family STANDS.
PRIOR_TEXT.value: this is the check that would have turned a 4-row finding into a false 28-row one.
PRIOR_TEXT.RETRACTED: This section concluded that limit:roll_divergent_lethality's comparison-limit adjudication STANDS. FALSIFIED: #1032 closed 15 of those 24 rows as a matcher artifact (reports/c91). The check here was sound as far as it went -- those rows are not THIS mechanism -- but I reported a negative result against one hypothesis as confirmation of the label, which it is not. The control row quoted, 19000001/11, was also misread by the branch_misses method: its arms are [-92, -92], not [-92, 0].

checked_and_rejected.STATUS: NOT RE-VERIFIED AFTER C94. The '0 of 8 -- their observed net is usually PRESENT in an arm' number was computed from branch_misses and has not been regenerated through replay. Its 8 rows were never named, so it cannot be audited. The soundness claim is withdrawn.
checked_and_rejected.why_the_conclusion_is_retained_anyway:
CORRECTED after review. The earlier wording -- 'the parse biases toward absent, so finding present anyway is conservative' -- was wrong: the broken parse has TWO failure modes pulling in OPPOSITE directions. Hiding real arms biases toward 'absent'. But FABRICATING a phantom net-0 arm biases toward 'PRESENT' whenever the observed slot net is itself 0. Both counterexamples below are exactly zero-net-slot rows, so under the broken parse both would have been scored 'present' falsely. A one-directional claim about a two-directional error is the shape of the thing C94 retracted.
The conclusion survives via a step the earlier text did not make: A SLOT WHOSE OBSERVED NET IS 0 CANNOT BE RESIDUAL-DECIDED LETHALITY BY CONSTRUCTION, because the mechanism requires the observed side to take a direct hit AND a residual, which is necessarily nonzero. So the false-PRESENT mode can only mis-score rows that structurally cannot be this mechanism, and the false-ABSENT mode is conservative. With that clause the argument closes.
checked_and_rejected.counterexamples_found_by_review: replaying 10 of the 24 limit:roll_divergent_lethality rows found at least two where a slot's observed outcome is absent from EVERY arm: 19000024/61 (Showdown: p1 takes nothing; only engine arm p1 capped_lethal=-95 -- a Destiny Bond row) and 19000077/47 (Showdown: p2 takes nothing; only arm p2 capped_lethal=-270 -- a Rest row). Neither is residual-decided lethality, so this report's conclusion survives, but BOTH LOOK LIKE ENGINE BUGS SITTING UNDER A limit: LABEL and need their own adjudication.
checked_and_rejected.action: open a follow-up to replay all 24 limit:roll_divergent_lethality rows and name them.
